column2: [intro]
In this curious world, everyone has their say,
We love to debate, even when we disagree, it’s the way.
Some say yes, others say no, each with their conviction,
But when we gather, it's a clash of opinions’ friction.
The jumble of views, it goes every which way,
We barely listen, we talk much louder, let’s sway.
The jumble of views, it sparks and it flies,
But beneath all this racket, the truth still lies.
Some are radical, always convinced they're right,
Others are uncertain, seeking perfection’s light.
But I say we can agree even if we don’t align,
Let’s give a little room, find common ground divine.
The jumble of views, it goes every which way,
We barely listen, we talk much louder, let’s sway.
The jumble of views, it sparks and it flies,
But beneath all this racket, the truth still lies.
[ solo ]
The jumble of views, it’s our quirky dance,
In this joyful disorder, we find balance and chance.
So let’s all sing together, in this world so split,
The jumble of views, it’s our eternal wit.
[outro]
